description:
Private push-to-talk dictation that runs entirely on your machine.

Koegaki is push-to-talk dictation for Windows. Hold a key, speak, and your words appear wherever you are typing. The speech model runs entirely on-device, so audio and text never leave your machine. No account, no cloud, no subscription. 30-day free trial, then a one-time purchase covers Mac and Windows.
- The cleanup model now downloads on its own after the speech model, so Clean turns on at once when you want it. Clean stays off until you turn it on, and once the model is on this PC, the Home card offers to turn it on in one click.
- The cleanup download waits while your connection is metered, and does not start when the disk lacks 2 GB to spare beyond the model. Settings shows where it stands, and offers Download now when the connection or the disk holds it back.
- Choosing Quit Koegaki in the tray, or Install and restart for an app update, now gives changes made in Settings time to save before Koegaki closes, as its own restarts already did.
- When Koegaki reopens itself after a crash, it now always checks the speech model files in full before loading them, even if the record of an earlier check could not be removed.
